title: SkillsAuditParams
description: Params for skills.audit: which discovered skill to read. One skill, because one skill is what a card is about — and because this is the one skills method that spends a model call, so it is asked for by name, once, when a person presses a button. Nothing about the model is a parameter: which model reads the skill is the auditing role's assignment, resolved on the backend in the one place a role becomes an (endpoint, model) pair.
